title: Analyzing Political Bias in LLMs via Target-Oriented Sentiment Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring prediction inconsistency in target-oriented sentiment classification by substituting the names of politicians from different political alignments into controlled sentence templates.
Analyzing target-oriented sentiment classification differences using a control group of fictional names to compare sentiment predictions between male and female entities.

Evaluating target-oriented sentiment classification differences using a control group of fictional names to compare sentiment predictions across different countries of origin, specifically noting variations for Russian and non-Western names.
